rss: Fuel prices added to Google Maps as petrol and diesel costs soar
title: Map Adds Snack Shop Prices!
story: Snack shops are now on the map with prices! This helps everyone find cheaper treats nearby.
storyBig: Snack shop prices are now listed on maps, making it easier for consumers to locate the best deals in their area. This change comes in response to rising candy and snack costs.
think: How do you find the best prices for treats?
bull: Finding cheaper snacks is now easier!
bear: Prices are rising, making snacks costlier.

rss: AI chip boom pushes Samsung profits to record $80bn
title: Robot Chip Boom! Profits Soar
story: Robot chips are super popular and making companies lots of money. Kids love playing with cool robots!
storyBig: The demand for advanced robot chips has surged, leading to significant profits for companies. This trend is expected to continue as technology integrates further into play and education.
think: Why do you think robot chips are so popular?
bull: Robot toys are more fun and smart now!
bear: High demand means prices might increase.
